stops.title: Wo Nhwɛbea
stops.caption: Deɛ ɛyɛ wo dea nko ara.
stops.speech: Yei ne wo nhwɛbea. Biribiara a ɛwɔ ha yɛ wo dea: wo akuo, wo mmaeɛ, ne deɛ asɔre no hia firi wo hɔ nnawɔtwe yi.

stops.title: Deɛ wotumi hunu
stops.caption: Nkyɛnmu tiawa nkyerɛ sɛ biribi ayera.
stops.speech: Wo nkyɛnmu yɛ tiawa ɛfiri sɛ Kairos fa kɛseɛ no nyɛ wo dea sɛ wohwɛ so. Yɛmfa biribiara nsie wo.

stops.title: Wo Mmaeɛ
stops.caption: Ɔsom biara a wɔkyerɛwee wo din.
stops.speech: Me Mmaeɛ kyerɛ ɔsom biara a wɔkyerɛwee wo, wo ntoatoasoɔ, ne sɛdeɛ wo mmaeɛ teɛ nnawɔtwe kakra a atwam.

stops.title: Wo Fekuo
stops.caption: Kuo ketewa a woka ho.
stops.speech: Fekuo kyerɛ kuo a woka ho, berɛ a wɔhyia ne baabi. Sɛ wonka bi ho a, mfonini no bɛhwehwɛ deɛ ɛbɛn wo.

stops.title: Wo Adwumakuo
stops.caption: Akuo a woyɛ adwuma wɔ mu.
stops.speech: Adwumakuo kyerɛ akuo a wosom wɔ mu, berɛ a ɛdi hɔ a wobɛyɛ adwuma, ne atadeɛ a wɔde bɛyɛ saa ɔsom no.

stops.title: Kyerɛw wo din
stops.caption: Skan, na wɔakyerɛw sɛ wobaeɛ.
stops.speech: Sɛ woduru a, bue Nkyerɛwee na skan kod a ɛwɔ ɛpono ano hɔ. Ɛno kyerɛw wo sɛ wobaeɛ a wonnyina ntoatoasoɔ mu.

stops.title: Nkrataa
stops.caption: Asubɔ, adanseɛ, ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔaba foforɔ.
stops.speech: Nkrataa ne baabi a wobisa asubɔ, woka adanseɛ, anaa wokyerɛw obi a ɔaba nnansa din. Ɔkannifoɔ gye firi hɔ.

stops.title: Wo Nsɛm
stops.caption: Wo nsɛm, ne hwan na ɔhunu.
stops.speech: Wo nsɛm kora wo nkitahodie ne wo nhyehyɛeɛ, a kasa a Kairos de kasa kyerɛ wo ka ho.
